newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble steady on U.S. holiday, flat c. bank rate.
newsitem.headline: Rouble steady on U.S. holiday, flat c. bank rate.

text.p: The rouble was little changed on Monday and dealers said trading was quiet due to the U.S. holiday while unchanged central bank rates could also steady the rouble.
U.S. banks, used by their Russian counterparties for settlement, are closed today for Labor Day.
"Everything is quiet because of the holiday, nobody seems willing to do anything," one dealer said and added that the central bank's rates, unchanged from Friday, could be another calming factor.
The central bank said it had kept 5,325/5,365 as its bid and offer rates against the dollar on Monday.
Deals for today settlement are not being struck due to the U.S. holiday. Tomorrow roubles were quoted at 5,360-63 per compared with an early 5,358-61 and Friday's late 5,363-66.
Overnight rouble credits yielded 1-5 percent compared with 5-10 percent late on Friday.
Dealers said the rouble was likely remain more or less stable all this week.
"Commercial banks may be seeking roubles for compulsory reserves of funds (in the central bank)," Konversbank dealer Igor Mamkov said.
